title: 구독 해지
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Hip-Hop track featuring aggressive male rap vocals and a heavy trap-influenced beat. The arrangement centers on a distorted, sliding 808 bassline and a high-pitched, staccato synth lead playing a repetitive minor-key hook. Percussion consists of a crisp snare on the backbeat, rapid-fire hi-hat rolls, and a punchy kick drum. Occasional record scratches and vocal shouts punctuate the transitions. The tempo is 145 BPM in the key of G# minor. The vocal delivery is rhythmic and percussive, alternating between rapid-fire verses and a repetitive, chanted chorus.
